shortDescription: Manage link aggregation groups on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches

options.name: check_running_config
options.description: Check running configuration. This can be set as environment variable. Module will use environment variable value(default:True), unless it is overridden, by specifying it as module parameter.

options.name: group
options.description: Channel-group number for the port-channel Link aggregation group. Range 1-255 or set to 'auto' to auto-generates a LAG ID

options.name: members
options.description: List of port members or ranges of the link aggregation group.

options.name: mode
options.description: Mode of the link aggregation group.

options.name: purge
options.description: Purge links not defined in the I(aggregate) parameter.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the link aggregation group.
